notes.title: The Wizards - Dark Times: Brotherhood Patch 1.28 is LIVE NOW!
notes.content:
We have released an exciting free update today, bringing a host of thrilling additions and enhancements to the game. Players can now experience the all-new Citadel of Aetheris, a stunning multiplayer map where strategy, teamwork, and powerful magic combine to create intense, action-packed battles.

[u][b]New Map: Citadel of Aetheris[/b][/u]
The new Citadel of Aetheris map offers a dynamic and challenging environment for players to test their magical prowess. This large multiplayer arena requires both strategic planning and teamwork to secure victory as players battle for dominance over the citadel using a variety of powerful spells and abilities. The Aetheris Citadel promises to become a key battleground for players seeking to conquer this magical stronghold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/a2b85194fbfc72cb273b88c9a44cbf04f3def039.png[/img]

[u][b]Other improvements[/b][/u]
In addition to the updates above, several other improvements have been made to enhance the overall gameplay experience. Spells have been rebalanced with changes to damage, range, and mechanics, making combat more strategic and exciting. Enemies have also been adjusted for greater challenge, with new health values and behavior changes. Other quality-of-life updates include a refreshed user interface, new class descriptions, improved menus, and faster progression with boosted XP rewards. Players can also toggle HP bars for enemies and enjoy new objectives in existing maps.

The full list of updates can be found below:

[b]New Map - “Citadel of Aetheris”[/b]
Re-balance of the multiplayer spells:
[*] Flame-thrower with increased damage, length(from 300 to 400) and radius of the spell.
[*] Fire-Lance switching hand position mechanic has been removed - for easier usage.
[*] Ice Sabers with increased damage(from 150 (Bash)/100(Throw) to 200(Bash)/125(Throw)).
[*] Icicle Projectiles with increased damage(from 50 to 85), faster loading (from 0.2s (per Icicle) to 0.12s), slightly slower flying speed (from 1500 to 1400).
[*]  Ice Nova with increased damage (from 10-50 to 30-90).
[*]  Chain Lightning with slightly decreased damage (from 50 to 45) and instead of jumping to 5 enemies now it'll jump to 4, smaller range (from 2000 to 1800).
[*]  Lightning Beam with increased damage (from 200 to 250).
[*] Lightning Hammer with increased damage (from 150 to 250), increased throwing speed and now is easier to catch due to a bigger catch threshold.
[*]  Rain of Arrows deals less damage on each class (from 5(dmg)x16(arrows) to 4x14).
New Sky lights in multiplayer maps.
Re-balance of the enemies:
[*] Fire Acolyte has more hp (from 550 to 800).
[*]  Fire type comes with greater strength dealing higher damage.
[*]  Ice types will have more endurance due to increased health points.
[*]  Lightning types will be more agile with their speed increased.
Now enemies also give more experience:
[*] Abigail from 300XP to 1000XP.
[*] Shroomlings from 6XP to 10XP.
[*]  Darklings from 10XP to 15XP.
[*] Grunts from 20XP to 30XP.
[*] Goblins from 10XP to 15XP.
[*]  Grunt Tanks from 40XP to 60XP.
[*]  Acolytes from 100XP to 150XP.
[*] ] Shamans from 75XP to  110XP.
[*] Shroomkings from 50XP to 125XP.
[*] Trolls from 125XP to 175XP.

[u][b]Additional Quality of Life enhancements:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added HP bars which you can switch on and off in the options.
[*] New objective on the Castle map. A constant fight to capture a crystal.
[*] Crystal ball with tips has been improved and we added 6 new tips, haptics, updated UI.
[*] Added class descriptions near the class statues.
[*] Added timer for Training Room bow mini-game.
[*] UI for the spell choosing has been improved f.ex haptics added, new electric icons.
[*] Updated Main Menu/Pause Menu - added haptics, refreshed color scheme, updated UI-tips, organized menu.
[*] Challenge board UI has been improved and is more readable.
[*] Added haptics in class-choosing altars.
[*] Added Icons with player’s levels per profile in the multiplayer menu.
[*] Added player’s current level in the pause menu.
[*] Overall UI, text, and pop-up's have been improved to be more appealing and to be more organized.
[*] Now players will get a pop-up which informs about other players waiting for you to join the battle.
[*] Collision/combat fixes on different maps.
[*] Added missing translations.
[*] Multiplayer HUB Quality of Life changes. Correcting collisions, changing height of some interactable objects.
[*] Crystals in Abigail fight should be easier to hit with spells.
[/list]

[*] Increased spell resistance of magic shields for all wizard classes in Primeweald Trials (Coop mode)

notes.content:
[h2]Good day to you, Wizards! 🖐️ [/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Even though the holidays are around the corner and 2023 is inevitably coming to an end, [b]we are not slowing down![/b] 🤓 In your reviews, discussions, and opinions, you've pointed out that there are a few gameplay elements that need minor tweaks and fixes, and we are always happy to listen to your feedback and respond to it.

Of course, our work on the major update improving the game's visuals, which we announced a few days ago, is in full swing, and we are also working on important fixes to solve problems with Index Controllers and Virtual Desktop... but for now, let us get back to the point.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/a3634481e1e24a4d4ce3dc60c5da7c93847526cf.png[/img]

[*] [b]Coop[/b] - Added a ground destruction effect when Abigail hits the ground during a boss fight.

[*] [b]Coop [/b]- Introduced a new texture for the portal effect where players confirm game sessions.
[*] [b]Coop [/b]- Fixed paths in doors in the Foggy Passage level to prevent enemies from getting stuck in them.
[*] [b]Coop [/b]- Increased the title captions on information boards by 15%.
[*] [b]Coop [/b]- Enhanced Shaman balance; they will now more frequently provide buffs that increase scale and enemy health.

[*] [b]General[/b] - Fixing issues with displaying translations in Chinese, Japanese, and Korean languages in Multiplayer Mode.

notes.title: We answer Community questions - check out the Brotherhood FAQ 📜
notes.content:
[h3]The Wizards - Dark Times: Brotherhood update FAQ is here![/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Following the recent unveiling of the Brotherhood release date, our Discord server and Social Media platforms have been [b]ablaze with excitement and activity...[/b] 🤩 And we just love it! 

Your curiosity regarding the gameplay of the Brotherhood update was quite evident, and we tried to answer your questions as efficiently and quickly as possible. However, [b]their numbers continued to increase[/b] with each passing hour... 🧙‍♂

Therefore, we decided that it would be easier to collect them all in one list and answer them collectively. And that's how [b]the Brotherhood's FAQ came to be! [/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/bbce446553045325e2597e307cb9a022b47b943c.png[/img]


[h2]Let's get to the questions![/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[b]1. Will the Brotherhood update will be available for PSVR2[/b]
- At this point, we can't say anything for sure, but know that we are fully aware of how fantastic and popular the PSVR2 platform is and how many great opportunities it offers. We'll be sure to let you know as soon as any specific information becomes available.


[b]2. What will be the Brotherhood price?[/b]
- No worries! The Brotherhood update is 100% free of charge.


[b]3. What exactly is the Brotherhood update?[/b]
- The Wizards – Dark Times: Brotherhood is a combination of two titles: 
• the remastered version of The Wizards - Dark Times, a story-rich singleplayer game released in 2020 (now with lots of fresh improvements, graphic revamp, and new enemies)
• the brand-new free co-op mode where you can join forces with up to two friends and face incoming dangers as a team of three powerful mages (the multiplayer mode features new maps with unique objectives, challenging boss fight, news spells and enemies)


[b]4. Will the Brotherhood update be released on Meta Quest 2 and Oculus Rift at the same time?[/b]
- Yeah! Along with the Steam and Viveport versions.


[b]5. Will I be able to play The Wizards - Dark Times: Brotherhood on Meta Quest 3?[/b]
- You will be able to enjoy the game on Meta Quest 3 with all its improvements and new features.


[b]6. Which platforms will get the Brotherhood update on the 19th?[/b]
- You can find the answer in point 3.


[b]7. Will there be a second Brotherhood beta?[/b]
- This is still to be decided, but (remembering how great the first one was) we really want to run another beta.


[b]8. Will the Brotherhood update feature cross-play?[/b]
- Yes, there is PCVR crossplay (Steam x Vive x Oculus Rift), but PCVR players won't be able to play with Quest users. 


[b]9. Is there a in-game voice communication?[/b]
- Yep! Brotherhood is all about teamwork and making friends, and that would not be possible without good, efficient voice communication!


[b]10. Are we still looking at the same class system from the beta with the same spell set?[/b]
- Yes, although we made a few minor adjustments such as assigning a different HP pool to each class, variations in the movement speed, durability of shields, or class-specific auras.


[b]11. While in the multiplayer mode, can I play as a team of two or solo?[/b]
- The choice is yours alone - you can play alone or with one or two friends.


[b]12. What are the character classes and do they have their own unique class spells?[/b]
- There are three character classes at your disposal: Fire Mage (damage dealer), Frost Mage (tank), and Storm Mage (support). Nevertheless, all of them, if used properly, are capable of inflicting high damage. Each class has a set of unique abilities.


[b]13. While in the multiplayer mode, are we limited to one Fire, one Frost, and one Storm mage?[/b]
- Again, the choice is yours! You can combine any kind of team you see fit: three tanky Frost Mages? Sure! Two Fire bursters and one Storm Wizard? No problem! We are sure you get the idea :) However, class diversity usually means easier run, as the classes complement each other.


[b]14. How many maps are there in multiplayer mode?[/b]
- There are five maps that differ from each other in appearance, atmosphere, and objectives to be completed. These include a boss fight map.


[b]15. Are maps in the multiplayer mode selected randomly?[/b]
- Yes, you never know what combination of maps to expect!


[b]16. Will Fire Wizards be able to conjure fire swords?[/b]
- No, but magic swords can be conjured by the Frost Mage. Fire Mage can summon a powerful magma lance.


[b]17. I would like to practice my spellcasting skills a little before I play online. Can I play with bots[/b]?
- There are no vs. bots mode, but worry not! A good training for online play is to go through a single-player campaign. Moreover, there is a training ground in the online lobby, where you can freely edit your skill tree and practice casting different spells.


[b]18. Is there a way to check my current HP state?[/b]
- There will be three crystals on your glove and they will mark your current HP.


[b]19. Have any bug fixes been implemented in the Brotherhood update?[/b]
- Yes, we got rid of bugs reported to us by the community.


[b]20. Will we see another trailer before the update is released?[/b]
- One more trailer is sure to be released.



[h2]Thank you for your continued support, everyone![/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Thank you for all your questions and the [b]overwhelming hype[/b] that we've experienced on our Discord and Social Media channels! 🤯 If you have any additional questions that didn't appear in our FAQ, we'd love to hear them!

Stay tuned, as more interesting info and numerous cool events are [b]coming soon![/b] As always - thank you and until next time, Wizards!

notes.title: Brotherhood Update - Enemies Overview
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings, Wizards! 🖐[/b][/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We don't know about you guys, but [b]we just LOVE[/b] all kinds of bestiaries, lorebooks, and guides 📚 Discovering long-forgotten secrets, viewing astonishing sketches, learning about the habits of mysterious beings, and of course[b] planning a strategy to defeat them[/b] are things every true adventurer dreams of! That is why we felt that such a rich and vast world as Meliora deserves its own unique tale. This tale may be quite [b]scary[/b]... yet very, very [b]interesting[/b]! 

Ok, are you brave enough to face the [b]hordes of hostile, magical creatures?[/b] Sure you are! After all, you are a wizard, right? Thanks to the bestiary below, you will learn how to fight against extremely dangerous foes. Be vigilant and soon you will discover their [b]strengths and weaknesses[/b], the way they fight, think, and move around the battlefield. Such knowledge can save your and your companions' lives, so take a deep breath, blow the dust off the ancient pages, and get right to it! 😗💨📜

[h2]Grunts[/h2]
Grunts are [b]the very core[/b] of the cruel forces you will face while playing the "Brotherhood" update. You can be sure you will encounter them on every single map, so you'd better be prepared... which won't be easy, as Grunts come in [b]many different kinds and forms[/b]. And it is not just about the elements variants (Basic, Fire, Frost, and Storm) but also their varied weapons and specializations! 🏹

Grunt is a [b]very versatile unit[/b]. It can attack you from a distance with its deadly bow or engage into the melee combat with use of a shield and sword. Each of them will effectively occupy your attention and force you to attack, protect yourself, or change your position. You certainly don't want to overlook the Shield Grunt, which protects itself with... well, a large shield. If you don't attack it from behind, it will soon get close to you and crush you with a deadly charge. Ouch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/a085c7762d0193d74ceca690b1278543fec0971b.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]Goblins[/h2]
Goblins may not be very big or strong, as their tactics are based on completely different traits. When you see a single Goblin, you can ignore it and focus on more dangerous opponents. Make no rookie mistake though and keep an eye on the upcoming Goblins - they will try to [b]swarm you with their great numbers[/b], and if you don't get rid of them quickly enough, you'll soon be in big trouble! 😬 Their little sharp daggers can do a lot of damage - especially when they stab their encircled victim from all directions.

As if that was not enough, in addition to the basic version, Goblins can also use the powers of Fire, Frost, and Storm. They are a small target, but most often one hit is enough to slay them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/878f936656f5dba0a019d2cd3f09632f3e3cc32a.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]Darklings[/h2]
Ugh... these guys are annoying, you can take our word for that! Unlike Goblins, Darklings will try to keep their distance and [b]shower you with their deadly bombs[/b] 💣 When you start chasing them, they will simply run away in search of a better spot. Depending on their type - Basic, Fire, Frost, or Storm - they will use different kinds of bombs. They can do a lot of damage to you and your team, so be careful!

Fortunately, Darklings also have a few weaknesses. They're not very strong, so they can't throw their projectiles too far - one of the best ways to defeat them is to outreach them and get rid of them from afar. In addition, they are [b]not very durable units[/b]... unless we're talking about a Darkling Captain or Darkling Champion! They are significantly better armored than their subordinates and are able to throw much bigger, more dangerous explosives. Bombs away!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/d82f1dc3bbd558b280f03296c922955b4bab0187.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]Shroomlings[/h2]
They may look somewhat cute, but they're extremely dangerous. When a Shroomling finds itself near the careless victim, it rushes toward them and... explodes! 🍄💥 This heroic suicide blast doesn't just hurt the target, but it also leaves a menacing thick cloud. Due to its rounded shapes and short legs, [b]Shroomling is rather slow[/b], which leaves us some time to react - you can either escape or destroy it from a safe distance.

But there is more... among the Shroomling tribes you can sometimes meet a champion! Champion Shroomling is much more poisonous than its minor brethren - it will leave a deadly smoke everywhere it goes and occasionaly release a [b]large cloud of spores![/b] Champions are known for their slowness and high damage resistance. All types of Shroomlings come in numerous elemental variants.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/af016e6f0250062f60e3bfbd84322b39c8d1b9ad.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]Shamans[/h2]
In addition to throwing dangerous projectiles at players, its main task is to [b]buff and heal nearby units.[/b] Shamans can increase their allies’ health pool, provide elemental resistance, or place a totem to heal them. Hitting the Shaman will be a real trick as it can teleport across the battlefield. Even so, [b]destroying them as your priority target[/b] will always be a good idea - buffed units can prove to be much more formidable and difficult to defeat... not to mention that Shamans will heal them and thwarted your efforts to hurt them! ☠️

The shaman comes in the Basic, Fire, Frost, and Storm form.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/aed1f8cd3503c92c08779d3c55c0b9f2b0b0df84.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]Witches and Acolytes[/h2]
Acolytes are the [b]masters of elemental magic[/b]. Each of them specializes in a different field - 
Fire Acolytes are known for their ability to inflict tremendous damage. Frost Acolytes use defensive magic and are very versatile. Storm Acolytes applies area damage and make Wizards to constantly change their positions. A challenge worthy of a true mage, so get ready for a demanding spellcasting duel! 🔥❄️⚡️ 

However, among your enemies, there is only one who has mastered the art of magic to perfection... Witches not only can use the vide range of spells (including dark Umbral spells), but also [b]create their own copies[/b] to confuse you and shower you with a magic projectiles. Defeating the witch is quite a challenge and it is best to attack her as a whole team!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/757962446aa86d13bd13d8ed8c96c40b96b3e2ed.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]Trolls and Battle Trolls[/h2]
When you hear his [b]heavy footsteps[/b] or see his gigantic body - be careful! This mighty beast will tirelessly [b]chase you[/b] and try to crush you, no matter what. The troll is a very resilient opponent and it will take many deadly spells to knock it down. Its secret weapon is the ability to throw huge boulders - being hit by such a missile could prove tragic! 😵

Battle Troll is a better armored and equipped version of this enormous giant. It may be a bit slower than the base type, but it makes up for it with its [b]exceptional durability[/b]. One hit of a Battle Troll can end the life of a careless Wizard, so make sure you always keep your distance from its huge, deadly mace!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/f521f8d8c092abdfef04c37beeeccf592831ed48.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[h3]Now you are prepared![/h3]
We hope that our bestiary will come in handy, when the time comes. [b]Hostile creatures of Meliora[/b] will do whatever they can to make it harder for you to complete the mission and advance to the next map. Fortunately, now you know what to expect from them and how to survive their wrath. [b]Well... at least in theory.[/b] 😁

With the help of [b]your fellow wizards[/b] you will surely develop lots of interesting tactics and ways to defeat your opponents! If luck is on your side, you will reach the Boss map... and believe us - things don't get easier around there! [b]Ok, that's it for today[/b] - thank you and see you next time, mages!

notes.title: Discover the Brotherhood Update game modes
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings, Wizards! 🖐[/b][/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The first Brotherhood Closed Beta is behind us, so it's a good time to thank our awesome testers and the whole The Wizards - Dark Times community! Thanks to [b]your overwhelming enthusiasm[/b], commitment, and absolutely great feedback we learned a lot about our game and found out how we can make it even better. We were delighted to discover that [b]100%[/b] of the testers surveyed would recommend the game to their friends based on their Beta experience. [b]Thank you, everyone[/b]! 🙏

However, today we want to tell you about something else. As you all surely know, the main axis of the Brotherhood update is [b]beating so-called maps[/b] 🗺️ Each of them is full of interesting elements, epic visuals, vicious enemies, and... [b]diversified objectives![/b] You and your friends will have to complete various tasks in order to beat a given map and move on to the next one. But how do you do that?


[h2]What challenges await you and your friends?[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Quick spellcasting, smart movement, and high accuracy are sometimes not enough! Yes, they are important, but still, if you don't [b]complete the map objectives[/b], your opponents will soon outnumber and overcome you! We don't want that to happen, do we?

As you progress through the game, you have to remember that each map has different goals... yet all of them have something in common. In order to open the portal leading to the next level, you must first complete the specific map objectives. Simple as that... or is it? We can't wait to see if your mage-squads can cope with the challenges we have prepared for you! Ok, are you ready to get to know [b]some of the objectives?[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/5c1145e98cf71f14ca225f489d538e44c90980a8.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[b]Collect and deliver[/b] - one of the challenges you will have to face will be finding the characteristic items and delivering them to the right place. Of course, your opponents will do their best to prevent you from completing this task! An example? Sure 😁 During your adventure in the Dark Woods you will have to find glowing mandrakes and throw them into huge cauldrons full of green, glowing goo! How fun!

[b]Seek and destroy[/b] - this kind of challenge is somewhat different in its assumptions. This time your mission will be to find the key elements of the map and destroy them. Easy to say, hard to do, as they are protected by hordes of powerful foes. Is it better to stick together? Or maybe split up in search of these unusual objects? It all depends on you!

[b]Get through[/b] - things are about to get messy. This mode will put your spellcasting skills to the difficult test. The goal here is simple and fun - to emerge victorious you will have to break through a narrow chokepoint. You need to have eyes all around your head, because the enemies will attack you from behind and from the front. Freeze, incinerate, or shock them and remember about the only rule - always move forward! 👣

Well... we will see. This is a very dynamic, highly combat-focused mode. Your survival will depend on your and your friends' spellcasting skills... and hey, make sure to resurrect them when they fall!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/295ee46e0b015493da6eec8111372ed9132a6202.gif[/img]


[h2]Test new tactics, mage classes, and spells![/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Of course, these are [b]not all[/b] variants of the game modes and maps - you will have to discover the rest of them for yourselves! Not to mention the boss fight zones... which is a tale for another day. 

One way or another, [b]adaptation is the key to victory[/b]. Be sure to check out all of the combinations, character development paths, and playstyles. The abilities of different Wizards complement each other perfectly and fill different niches. We believe that you and your friends will quickly discover your own way to victory 🤝 Only smart, efficient cooperation will allow you to understand and execute all the objectives... and that is something that even the most powerful magician in the world cannot do alone.

notes.title: Here it is! Multiplayer Mode FAQ
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Wizards![/b]

We know you've been waiting for this information! In fact, we were looking forward to finally sharing it with you too! We are [b]extremely happy[/b] to see your excitement and enthusiasm for the upcoming [b]Multiplayer Mode DLC[/b], so we decided to collect your questions asked over the past few weeks and... answer them in the form of [b]FAQ![/b]

We hope that the list of questions below contains all the answers you are looking for. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/2488bda82aeb6cd367a246975a70af58c27c84a8.png[/img]


[h2]The Wizards - Dark Times Multiplayer Mode DLC FAQ[/h2]


[b]1. When will the DLC be released? [/b]

- We plan to start beta testing in March or April - we will have to go through the first testers' opinions and find out how many problems arise during the beta, but we're aiming for the first half of the year! (Please don't take it as a promise!)


[b]2. Will the premiere take place on all platforms at the same time?[/b]

- Steam will be the first. Soon after, the DLC will be released on other platforms.


[b]3. How much will the Multiplayer Mode DLC cost?[/b]

- It will be completely free! We mean... we love you, dear players, and we want to thank you for your continued support! Thanks to your feedback we can make our games better and better! You already paid for our game once! 


[b]4. How many players will be able to join the game?[/b]

- Up to three players. Each of them will be able to take on the role of: Fire Mage, Frost Mage and Storm Mage.


[b]5. Will there be new spells?[/b]

- Oh yes! There will definitely be a lot (and I mean - a lot) of new spells! Some of the previous ones have undergone modifications, but still, players will discover that they have many new ways to defend Meliora!


[b]6. Will players be able to support each other's spells?[/b]

- Of course! All the elements at your disposal will interact with each other, and certain spell combinations may amplify others. This means that your team will have to learn to adapt to the current situation and use a variety of tactics.


[b]7. And what about opponents? Will we see new types of enemies?[/b]

- Definitely! Ultimately, we will have to face five completely new kinds of enemies. But there's more - the foes you already know from the basic version of the game will also appear in new varied variants - requiring a different approach and cooperation between players to defeat them.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35224474/c9daafb6a2ba83644239316f357d630f155b419e.png[/img]


[b]8. Will the graphics be improved?[/b]

- Many aspects have undergone a great revitalization. We improved the appearance of most spells and added new ones. We've also been working on the quality of textures and models. You can expect an improvement, however, it won't be a complete revolution.


[b]9. What will the core / loop of the gameplay look like?[/b]

- You and your friend will start the game in a special hub containing a magic portal. After crossing the portal, you will be sent on a quest taking place on two maps (randomly selected from a wide pool of maps) with different objectives and tasks. Collecting crystals and transporting them to the right place? Sure! Destroying specific items around the zone? Got it! Fighting off waves of enemies? Yep! Of course, there will be more kinds of such challenges. 

After beating these maps you will proceed to the boss map, where your spellcasting skills will be put to the ultimate test ːsteammockingː 

But hey - there's more! After extensive testing, we gave up the idea of ​​a Co-Op Campaign in favor of a more varied, replayable experience for up to three players. Having that in mind, we plan to introduce more Multiplayer modes in the future - more info on this soon!


[b]10. Will there be a cross-platform connection (e.g. Steam x Quest Store)?[/b]

- We are currently testing this feature, but it is too early to determine if it will appear in the DLC.


[b]11. Will there be an in-game voice chat?[/b]

- We make every effort to introduce voice chat into the game. After all, wizards have to get along somehow!


* Please note that there are still a few months left until the DLC release, so our plans may (slightly) change. 


[b]A few words from the Carbon Studio team:[/b]
For a long time, we wondered if we should publish this post in such a difficult time. In the end, we decided that publishing the answers to your most frequently asked questions would provide you with a glimmer of joy and a pleasant escape from the tragic events unfolding in Eastern Europe.

notes.title: Cleansing the Realm in Dark Times
notes.content:
Greetings Wizards,

with just 1 day left until launch, let's take a look at the minions of darkness you'll encounter and battle on your quest.

[h2]Unlit[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/XEa6fFII8IrLvBFPKx/giphy.gif[/img]

When the Umbral plague started to spread, its gloom affected all - but none more so than the simple tree folk of Primeweald. The lesser elves' bodies became twisted and hardened, their minds turned from cultivating plant life to violence and hatred. Bound to the dark force's will, they follow it blindly.

As the bulwark of the plagued army, the Unlit are not only skilled swordsmen, but deadly archers as well. When you're far away, they will mercilessly try to turn your body into Swiss cheese with arrows. If you dare to get close, they will transform their bow into a shield, and summon a sword to deal with you face to face. 

[h2]Darkling[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ZFVuti9uvRCv56J5nj/giphy.gif[/img]

Darklings have always been shifty little imps... but the Umbral plague made them extraordinarily annoying. With a knack for improvised explosives, the Darklings lurk where no other creatures can survive.

The Darklings utilize their agility and small size to support the plagued army. They will jump around any nosy Wizard and try to blow them up with smaller and bigger bombs. Fortunately, they're not very smart about it - sometimes they blow up themselves, or their fellow Darklings.

[h2]Shroomling[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/S3nDwMluhW0alHYu1R/giphy.gif[/img]

The Umbral plague also affected the whimsical fungi growing in the Forsaken Wood, making them much more territorial, and driving them to attack any foreigner with no regard for themselves.

Don't let the cute look fool you - filled with poisonous spores, the Shroomlings wait burrowed in the ground for their prey. Once you get close enough, they pop out and clumsily run toward you to explode and leave a lingering deadly gas cloud.

[h2]Fire Acolyte[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/J4af4TE68It2KqhrQx/giphy.gif[/img]

The elven sorcerers studying the power of the elements became the most powerful servants of darkness. Corrupted by the Umbral plague, they command magic to bring nothing but death and destruction. They are the true test of a Wizard's might.

The Fire Acolyte strikes with a blazing fury, hoping to put an end to your adventure. Watch out for their Fire Sentries, they can easily knock you out while you're distracted!

[h2]Ice Acolyte[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/kG3Cbj7uJpFYCmrYXS/giphy.gif[/img]

The Ice Acolyte commands the freezing powers, and tries to immobilize and finish off any trespassing Wizards. Their deadly icicles easily pierce through flesh, while their icy barrier heals and protects them from taking damage - do your best to destroy it before the Acolyte emerges fully healed!

[h2]Lightning Acolyte[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/LqaFOE0r4aowM9lo4c/giphy.gif[/img]

The Lightning Acolyte is electric power personified - with chaotic, erratic teleporting and swift melee strikes, they pose a great threat to any Wizard. Just when you think their attacks have stopped and you can finally breathe, expect a sudden lightning storm over your head! They know no rest while you're still alive.


Thank you for checking out this update, we hope you're ready to cleanse the realm! See you tomorrow on a grand adventure!

notes.title: Invoking Time!
notes.content:
Greetings Wizards,

With only 2 days left until launch, let's take a look at the entirely new spells in Dark Times.

[h2]Magma Burst[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/S3au8c8rJ5ZFAZFfXk/giphy.gif[/img]

Initially, we wanted to make this spell a stream of molten lava... isn't it better to blow stuff up though?
Your go-to "please disperse" spell, Magma Burst leaves a trail of destruction that sets enemies on fire, and explodes on impact (or releasing the Grip buttons). 
Cast the Fireball and press the Grip buttons while holding it, then drop the lava rock on the ground.

[h2]Arcane Beam[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/LnL8yXSYSwolS3aLO4/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]Vegeta, what does the scouter say about his power level?[/i]
The Arcane Beam is a concentrated, devastating magic force. Purifying the realm will be much easier once you get the hang of this spell.
Cast the Arcane Shield and press the Grip buttons while holding it, then spread out your hands and unleash the power.

[h2]Storm Nova[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/JpXqy6hb84hBRJhNsT/giphy.gif[/img]

It's easy to get overwhelmed while rescuing the world. If you ever feel like the enemies are too annoying or there's too many of them to catch a breath, just electrocute EVERYTHING around you. Everyone needs a break, even Wizards.
Cast Lightning, press the Grip buttons while your hands are filled with raw power, then spread your hands to the sides.

[h2]Ice Sabers[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Jn9ryEAkJNJeZoIzd7/giphy.gif[/img]

The freezing mechanic is one of the coolest (pun intended) features of Dark Times, but then you can also go into overdrive with Ice Sabers - your instant freezing solution. Smash them in the faces of your enemies in melee, or alternatively throw them - Ice Sabers know the way.
Cast the Frostbow, put your hands together, press both Grip buttons, and release to the sides - the ice heeds your command.

[h2]Radiant Shards[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/lSDYSkKGanRepwmgqg/giphy.gif[/img]

Ever feel like just punching fantasy creatures? Good news - with Radiant Shards, you can either punch or throw. The magical shards work best in close range, utilize the spread to the best of your ability!
Put your hand over your shoulder, press the Trigger, and straighten it to the other side to conjure Radiant Shards. Works with either or both hands!

[h2]Radiant Missiles[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/U6vMdNCqAkV99bFF2D/giphy.gif[/img]

The Radiant Missiles are the invoked form of Radiant Shards. When conjured, they suspend in the air until touched by your hand - then, they launch in the sky and seek the nearest target. A very powerful spell for... well, dark times.
Cast the Radiant Shards, put your hands together and press the Grip buttons, then spread them to the sides to conjure Radiant Missiles.

[h2]Arcane Pulse[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/mGWUHZUb1LQTnAEPwH/giphy.gif[/img]

The last addition to the spell arsenal, the Arcane Pulse means raw, directed kinetic power. Make the enemies, crates, barrels and torches back off with a swift and precise motion in a Jedi-like manner.
To cast Arcane Pulse, put your hand forward, press the Grip button, pull your hand toward your chest, then push forward and release the Grip. Arcane Pulse can be cast in either or both hands (stronger effect with both!)

[b]Thank you for checking out this update, we're thrilled to sling spells with you in just 2 days![/b]

notes.title: Introduction to the Reworked Classic Spells
notes.content:
Greetings Wizards,

Dark Times are creeping ever closer! We thought it’d be better for the Realm if you knew what you were doing with the power we’re going to put in your hands. In this community update we’re going to take a look at the reworked Classic Spells.

[h2]Fireball[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0mPVHQN.gif[/img]

The gesture system is back, and this time one-handed spells can be cast in either hand.
Definitely your go-to “PANIC” spell, the Fireball will act like a living flame seeking target that deals damage and sets the opponent aflame on impact. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gu4VePt.gif[/img]

You might notice that the first thing that appears in your hand when casting is just an ember. Before this change, during internal playtesting, we noticed one of our level designers perfected the motions of casting and throwing Fireballs, essentially turning himself into a weird fusion of machine gun and flamethrower. After obliterating the entire stage in mere minutes, leaving only scorched earth in his wake, he just said “good spell”. Can’t blame him, it is a good spell.
However, with the goal of encouraging the player to use different spells to control combat, we decided to prevent Fireball spam. With the slight ember ignition delay, casting this spell feels much more natural now.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5k4tIpP.gif[/img]

[h2]Frostbow[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kDX86vt.gif[/img]

We’re very glad with how the Frostbow turned out in Dark Times. This spell is cast with both hands, and accompanied by controller vibration when drawing an Ice Arrow. Instead of being just another way to deal damage, the spell’s utility is more focused on crowd control now. Ice Arrows are quick, precise, and efficient, making them an ideal tool for handling chaotic encounters.
Shooting an enemy once will make them Chilled and slower, while shooting them twice will make them Frozen and immobile. Finding out the best spell combos to exploit these states will be your key to victory!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/39GxrOw.gif[/img]

[h2]Arcane Shield[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1pwjHAn.gif[/img]

Your trusty Arcane Shield will be your most valued possession in the spell arsenal, and benefits greatly from being cast in either hand, depending on the situation. Your Wizard body is frail, but your magic powers are immense. Protect yourself the best way you can. The journey through the plagued land of Meliora will be perilous, and filled with hostile creatures and traps. 
Thankfully, the shield can be used as a weapon as well. Bash your enemies away, or throw it like Captain America for magical damage in a pinch.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/if2vm3c.gif[/img]

[h2]Lightning[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PqLVZKE.gif[/img]

Cast with both hands, Lightning was one of the fan-favorites in The Wizards, and we don’t think it’ll change much in Dark Times. The unlimited power is more unlimited than ever, now paralyzing enemies and featuring a wider area of effect that focuses on single targets. For enhanced performance, Chill an enemy with Ice Magic, melt the frost with Fire Magic, and then hit them with Lightning. Wet opponents stand no chance against electric current.
Unfortunately, flat .gifs don’t do it justice!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SorQl31.gif[/img]

Thank you for checking out our first community update on Steam! Part 2 of the Spells series will come in the next few weeks. 

As always, we encourage you to follow us on social media and join our Discord community where we hang out most days. Contests, updates and Wizard banter included.
